field_units.sat_mjd: MJD TCB for @; observatory-clock MJD for pks
field_units.torb_s: s; added to spin time, subtracted from pet

input_metadata.BINARY: case-sensitive source dispatch string after parsing
input_metadata.EPHEM: DE405 declared for synthetic fixtures; original DDH DE414 unchanged
input_metadata.EPHVER: 5; no preprocessing/TEMPO1 emulation in synthetic pipeline
input_metadata.TIM: FORMAT 1; original decimal frequency MHz, MJD epoch and uncertainty microseconds preserved in committed file; @ already barycentric TCB, pks observatory clock

parameter_units.param_a1dot: storage light-seconds/s; PAR at k=0 multiplied by binary64 1e-12 if abs(value)>1e-7; ELL1H update accumulates err instead of replacing it
parameter_units.param_a2dot: X2DOT storage literal; T2 multiplies by tt0^2/2 in s^2, MSS additionally uses binary64 1e-20. A2DOT parser alias writes param_a1dot[1], not param_a2dot.
parameter_units.param_afac: dimensionless aberration scale in T2 calcGR
parameter_units.param_bp: source beta-prime dimensionless coefficient; T2 prints unimplemented warning
parameter_units.param_bpjom: raw token: BTJ adds directly to radians, T2 adds to degrees; updates add raw increment without conversion
parameter_units.param_bpjpb: raw token: BTJ adds directly to seconds, T2 multiplies by 86400; BTJ/T2 updates add raw increment
parameter_units.param_bpp: source beta-double-prime dimensionless coefficient; T2 prints unimplemented warning
parameter_units.param_daop: D_AOP token literal; reader comment pc and initializer label kpc disagree. T2 getPostKeplerian uses value*1e-3/(pi/180/3600*1e-3) exactly; retain source conversion
parameter_units.param_decj: PAR sexagesimal d:m:s converted through binary64 dms_turn/turn_deg*pi/180 to radians stored in binary128
parameter_units.param_dth: dimensionless angular eccentricity distortion; T2 uses DTH
parameter_units.param_dtheta: dimensionless angular eccentricity distortion; DD/MSS use DTHETA
parameter_units.param_e2dot: MSS storage literal interpreted times binary64 1e-20 s^-2; no readParfile E2DOT route found; absent-zero callback/update probed only
parameter_units.param_edot: storage s^-1; PAR multiplied by binary64 1e-12 if abs(value)>1e-7; BT/BTJ/BTX ignore value in delay despite some derivative/update routes
parameter_units.param_eps1dot: s^-1; PAR multiplied by binary64 1e-12 if abs(value)>1e-7; ignored by ELL1k delay
parameter_units.param_eps2dot: s^-1; PAR multiplied by binary64 1e-12 if abs(value)>1e-7; ignored by ELL1k delay
parameter_units.param_f: Fk s^(-k-1); direct binary usage F0 Hz
parameter_units.param_fb: FBk storage s^(-k-1); BTX/ELL1 fitting update +=val/(1e7)^(k+1).
parameter_units.param_ifunc: SIFUNC integer selector; ELL1 tests this for orbital sinc branch
parameter_units.param_m2: storage solar masses; local Shapiro seconds uses binary64 constant 4.925490947e-6. T2-PTA update divides fit increment by this constant; other implemented updates add solar masses.
parameter_units.param_mtot: storage solar masses; local geometric seconds. DDGR derived mode mutates parameters.
parameter_units.param_nharm: integer harmonic count parsed to binary128 then cast to int
parameter_units.param_om2dot: MSS storage literal multiplied by binary64 1e-20/an^2 then ae^2/2; initializer label says rad/yr^2 but executable formula uses seconds through an; no reinterpretation
parameter_units.param_omdot: storage degrees/Julian year; BT/BTJ/BTX/ELL1/ELL1k/DDGR/MSS updates convert rad/s via 86400*365.25*180/pi; DD/DDK/DDS/DDH/T2/T2-PTA/ELL1H updates add literal degrees/year
parameter_units.param_orbifunc: SORBIFUNC selector 0/1/2; ORBIFUNCn triples are MJD, orbital turns, uncertainty, parsed as binary64
parameter_units.param_orbpx: MSS reciprocal kpc; converted by 1/3.086e21 to reciprocal cm
parameter_units.param_pb: PAR/storage days; local period seconds. BT/BTJ/T2 update +=val days; other PB updates +=val/86400 days.
parameter_units.param_pb2dot: storage s^-1; T2 orbit term uses -pb2dot*(tt0/pb)^3/6 exactly; no scientific correction
parameter_units.param_pbdot: storage s/s; PAR value at k=0 multiplied by binary64 1e-12 if abs(value)>1e-7; companion declarations do not use this heuristic; additive update
parameter_units.param_pmdec: mas/Julian year; converted to radians/s in binary models
parameter_units.param_pmra: mas/Julian year; converted to radians/s in binary models
parameter_units.param_px: mas; converted to radians in binary models
parameter_units.param_raj: PAR sexagesimal h:m:s converted through binary64 hms_turn/turn_deg*pi/180 to radians stored in binary128
parameter_units.param_shapmax: dimensionless for DDS/T2: sini=1-exp(-SHAPMAX); MSS instead uses literal as a delay amplitude in seconds
parameter_units.param_sini: dimensionless; SINI KIN link computes sin(KIN). Source clamps differ by model/precision.
parameter_units.param_track: dimensionless source tracking control; absent here
parameter_units.param_xomdot: storage degrees/year; T2 divides by an*(180/pi)*365.25*86400
parameter_units.param_xpbdot: storage s/s; PAR multiplied by binary64 1e-12 if abs(value)>1e-7; additive update where implemented

representation.geometry: Actual formBatsAll DE405 Earth vector and normalized source psrPos, equatorial J2000 for these fixtures. Barycentric input does not imply zero Earth vector.
representation.numeric: String; 36 significant digits with exact binary128 parse-back assertion. A native double is promoted exactly for serialization, never recomputed at higher precision.
representation.phase: phase_turn is source full phase after original-first-TOA fractional reference removal. nphase_turn is source nearest integer of reduced phase. reduced_phase_reconstructed_turn is phase_turn minus the source phaseint expression, an explicitly named postprocessing field. Mean removal changes residual_s only.
representation.precision: param.val/err and spin arithmetic binary128 (113-bit significand); wrapper arguments/return binary64 (53-bit). DD native return binary128; other model returns binary64. Internal double locals/constants/math are preserved.
representation.source_failure: Exit/signal/timeout and last completed JSONL record retained. No result is invented for a started call that did not return.
representation.state: Complete initialized val/err/paramSet/fitFlag arrays restored before each request. Observations copied bytewise after formBatsAll. repeats>1 deliberately retains state within that request. prefitErr is a separate parser field, not an update error.
representation.undefined_source: Run in its own process; source_semantics=undefined_source and no value/class/narrowed_binary64 published.
representation.update_units: Derivative is source fitting-coordinate response, not asserted to equal a mathematical finite difference. Update expressions in the pinned model source define each coordinate. All supplied increments and uncertainties parse through strtod.

requirements.acceptance: No Rust budgets or milestone acceptance. Exact equality here means regeneration with this A2 library/compiler/runtime only.
